'''Archais''' was a celestial body<ref name="AIR" /> located in the [[Archais system/Legends|Archais system]]. It was situated in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Archais lay on the [[Gallinore Reach]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]], which connected it to the [[Lalmy'ash system/Legends|Lalmy'ash]] and [[Selab system/Legends|Selab systems]],<ref name="TEA" /> and featured [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] on its surface.<ref name="AIR" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Archais was said to be the site of very tall mythical [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] peaks.<ref name="Questal" /> At one point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> a number of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] units engaged a faction of the [[Assassin's Guild/Legends|Assassin's Guild]], backed by an Imperial force [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] [[Freja Covell]], in a [[Battle of Archais|battle]] throughout Archais' eastern [[Water/Legends|seas]], including at the [[Tylerin Embankment]].<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Archais was first mentioned in ''[[The Game Chambers of Questal]]'', a [[1990]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure written by [[Robert Kern]].<ref name="Questal" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Archais [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Archais itself, in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
